summary: The Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting its second quarter fiscal 2026 earnings for the period ended April 30, 2026. The release discloses net income of $2,632 million (C$), diluted EPS of $2.00, and a Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio of 13.3%. No special-situation transaction—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist event—is announced. This is a routine quarterly earnings report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a domestic earnings press release, with no structural corporate event requiring classification under the special-situations framework.
